SECTION V
PROJECT ALTERNATIVES
The alternatives to the projects included in the Community Development Block Grant program for the next three years are numerous. An almost endless variety of specific project alternatives could be identified, plus more generalized alternative project areas and project emphasis.
This discussion of project alternatives will identify the major CDBG proposals which were not selected for the three-year program and assesses the relative impact of these rejected projects relative to the chosen projects. Further, this section will address the general alternatives of concentrating CDBG monies in specific limited project categories, such as public works, parks, housing rehabilitation, etc. The no project alternative will also be examined.
